notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]VR Support[/h3][p]Added VR support. The entire game can be played in VR in single or multiplayer (with VR or flat-screen players). Also, the difficulty is slightly reduced if all players in the session play in VR.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added a quest for the Smiling TV Head.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the area. [spoiler](Laboratory and Basement)[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p][spoiler]Added a way to deal with the Orangeheads.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 new achievements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new dialogues for the TV heads.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Added map markers for Energy retainers and some targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Save terminals no longer allow saving immediately after someone dies (Previously, when saving like this, the terminal would restore everyone, excluding those who died recently).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the speed of the worm on the second floor of the annex.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the layout on the second floor (main building and annex), added another Save Terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]The character no longer turns behind the camera while playing gestures.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the first-person gesture option.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly changed the light from the Hand Lamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced camera shaking when running.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the distance at which the monster on the 3rd floor could turn around to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the view angle for Annex Keeper.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased max volume of voice chat. Remove low quality for voice chat in lobby or among dead players.[/p][/*][*][p]Other small changes.[/p][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3]Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the map in the menu could move beyond the visible borders and cease to be [/p][p]available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Monster on the 3rd floor could get stuck immediately after destroying the wall. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera being hard-wired during dialogue, which could cause dialogue text to not be visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing collision on locked doors, allowing capsules to be pushed through them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some navigation issues.

[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: VR Update Testing
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm currently working on Update 1.1, which will include VR support. If you have a VR headset, you already can try it out now by selecting the "vr_update" beta branch.

Right now, this is an early version, but it will be gradually improved until the full release of the update. All features, including multiplayer, are supported in this branch - just make sure everyone in the lobby is using the same beta branch.

If you encounter any bugs, issues, or just want to share feedback, you can:

[list]
[*]Fill out the [url=https://forms.gle/nm1gP6jEk1MBjYrU6]feedback[/url] form,

[*]Leave a comment in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3176060/discussions/0/601906153570490445/]this Steam discussion[/url], or

[*]Message on the Discord server.
[/list]


Thanks for testing, and enjoy the VR experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158027/a6909b7914ea237f97825e91b915a1658909b3d0.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo at Steam Next Fest and Release Date!
notes.notes:
Demo at Steam Next Fest and Release Date!

The demo version of Emissary Zero is participating in Steam Next Fest.
And I'm excited to announce that the full version will be released on March 28! Add it to your Wishlist!

P.S. Thank you to everyone who provided feedback on the demo. A critical bug that caused some items to disappear has been fixed. Additionally, game invites for online play have been added. If you can't find a session through "Join multiplayer game," try using an invitation to join instead.
